messages:
sam: Heads-up — users flagged missing logs for some GPU reclaim incidents. Traces show spans but Loki returns nothing for the same trace IDs in the 01:10-01:25 UTC window. Anyone else seeing correlation gaps?

ingrid: Yup, I noticed gaps in us-west-2. Ran a top-level chunk query and saw a bunch of small chunks marked deleted around 01:15. Could be compactor/retention overlap.

maria: I ran a raw loki query for trace_id=9f2e3a4b and only the root span log is present. Forwarder logs show dropped batches around that time. Paste from loki-forwarder stdout: 
```
2026-02-12T01:11:12Z ERROR forwarder/shipment.go:87 failed to send batch: write udp: connection reset by peer
2026-02-12T01:11:13Z WARN  forwarder/retry.go:45 retry=1 backoff=200ms
2026-02-12T01:11:14Z ERROR forwarder/shipment.go:87 failed to send batch: write udp: connection reset by peer
```

devops-bot: ALERT: loki-forwarder error rate > 5% for tenant=gpu-backend (01:11:30 UTC) :rotating_light:

alex: Cloud infra shows ENI flaps in the same window on the GPU node pool — eni-12c had a brief transmit drop. If the forwarder uses UDP or small timeouts, partial batches get lost.

tess: Also saw compactor activity at 01:15:08: 
```
2026-02-12T01:15:08Z INFO compactor/compaction.go:276 delete-range tenant=gpu-backend from=1676196600 to=1676197500 status=success
2026-02-12T01:15:09Z INFO compactor/compaction.go:314 compaction finished tenant=gpu-backend
```

sam: That matches the theory: compactor deleted chunks before the forwarder retried successfully, leaving traces (in APM) without corresponding logs. Short-term: increase GPU tenant retention by +1h and bump forwarder retries. Long-term: make compactor/shipper coordination stronger (delete only after confirmed delivery).

ingrid: For mitigation I bumped tenant retention to +3600s (temporary) and increased forwarder retries from 3 -> 6. Also reduced forwarder batch_size from 512 -> 256 to lower packet loss risk. Changes applied at 01:35 UTC.

maria: Can we update the SLO/dashboard? We should add an alert that annotates when trace_count > log_count for the same trace_id vector. Proposed Grafana Loki query to find gaps: 
```
sum by (tenant) (rate(apm_spans_total[5m])) - sum by (tenant) (count_over_time({job=\"loki\"} |= \"trace_id\"[5m]))
```
Flag when > 0.2 * traces for 5m. Also add label tenant=gpu-backend so we can target this specifically.

alex: PR for shipper backoff & improved acking: https://git.internal/redwood/loki-forwarder/pull/412 (canary + rollout planned). I'll kick the canary at 03:00 UTC.

sam: Thanks — follow-ups: schedule a repair/reindex job against object store for 01:05-01:30 window to backfill logs if available, and add a synthetic that cross-checks trace vs log counts per minute for each tenant. Also track forwarder error_rate as an SLI. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Deployment scheduled: forwarder canary rollout at 03:00 UTC (expected 15m).
